reviews.title: Amoled for the Win!
reviews.comment: I got this item when it went on sale for $199.99. Compared to other aio's this is priced competitively. Comes exactly as pictured and screen quality is amazing. The screen is controllable within the Jungle Leopard software, and super customizable. You can upload anything you want to display on the screen from gifs, video files and custom temp readings. Just hoping quality of the pump and screen lasts.

reviews.title: So many flaws for an esthetically pleasing aio
reviews.comment: Yes i was intised to get this i mean the price for what u get on paper is amazing and if ur just gonna use the aio (the fans it comes with et etc) then yes its 4 or 5 out of 5 stars, but the flaws come out first when u ned to remove the fans off the aio that come pre-installed..u have to removed glued on rubber corner peaces that ar not only hard to get off b7t if u so get them off they probably wont go back on so it looks like crap. I wanted a push pull config and first porblem is they sont xoke with anymore long radiator screws only the 4 kinda long ones that came with the radiator fans which by the way is one bug fan. I wanted my own fans and a push pull, dude if u wanna change the orientation of the one big fan that comes with the aio u kinda cant in order to use thus fan as a push (the fan that goes on back) i had to poke wholes in the rubber and only use 2 screws becuae I ran out of screws.. PLEASE TAKE MY ADVICE!! ** if u wanna customize this aio and ur cool with the fans as yes 5 out of 5 its the best for the money, if u wanna use your own fans its kinda a hassle and it goes down to w or e outta 5. Its your choice.

reviews.title: Good AIO
